findings.text: Comparing via UnixNano() overflows int64 for times outside roughly years 1678–2262, and the result is undefined for the zero time.Time (year 1). For example, Greater(time.Time{}, time.Unix(0,0)) can give a wrong ordering. Use Before/After/Equal, or compare Unix() seconds and then nanoseconds.
